title: nfl.player_season
description: Sports task contract (S1) for task='nfl.player_season'. Mirrors selflearn_core.contracts_sports.SPORTS_TASKS['nfl.player_season']; the Python validator is the source of truth and a test keeps the required keys here equal to it. Horizon: season; horizon_s >= 1.

ts.description: unix seconds, prediction time; must be <= meta.kickoff_ts when present (no lookahead)

model_version.description: the shipped rule, e.g. weekly_split_v2 | candidate | parlay_v2

meta.description: Measurement-only side channel. kickoff_ts (unix seconds) enables the no-lookahead check; market prices (market_prob, closing_line, ...) live here.

candidate_signals.description: candidate signal values keyed by signal name

features.description: Point-in-time features known at ts. Market prices are NOT allowed here (keys implied_prob, market_prob, closing_line, moneyline, spread_line, kalshi, polymarket are rejected at any depth); put them under meta.

outcome.description: Realized payload (Outcome.realized) once the event is final. Unresolved events have no outcome at all.
